You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The reporting service still relies on the event bus as of 2025-11-13. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-13]
- The webhooks service belongs to Team Atlas as of 2025-09-09, after Ember handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-09-webhooks]

    earlier: The webhooks service is a Boreal service as of 2025-01-09. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-04-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]

    earlier: The event bus belongs to Team Dune as of 2025-09-09, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-09-09 to 2025-11-24; recorded by handover/2025-09-09-event-bus]

- Ember handed the webhooks service to Team Atlas on 2025-09-09. [valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-09-webhooks]
- Boreal handed the event bus to Team Dune on 2025-09-09. [valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-09-event-bus]
- The event bus pager rings the Boreal team, not Team Dune, as of 2025-11-24. [decision; valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
- The webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout. [valid 2025-04-22 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-22-2]
- The event bus deploys only on weekdays after 15:00 UTC per the change policy. [constraint; valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-17-2]
    earlier: The event bus deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC per the change policy. [constraint; valid 2025-04-22 to 2026-03-17; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-22]
- The webhooks service will require an idempotency key on every delivery. [decision; valid 2026-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- As of 2025-09-19, the reporting service reads from the event bus instead of querying Ledger directly. [decision; valid 2025-09-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-19]
- Team Dune reported on 2025-12-08 that the event bus's request volume halved following the client rollout. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-08-2]
- Boreal decided at standup on 2026-05-05 that the event bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. [decision; valid 2026-05-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-05]
- The webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys. [decision; valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-16]
- Team Boreal reported at standup on 2025-11-11 that the event bus's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-11-2]
- After the cache change, the webhooks service's memory use grew steadily for a week. [valid 2025-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-11-2]
- Marcus Oyelaran wrote up the handover doc for Tomasz for the event bus handover on 2025-09-09. [valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-09-event-bus]
- The webhook dispatcher is owned by Team Dune as of 2026-04-22, after Team Atlas kept it until then. [decision; valid 2026-04-22 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-22-webhooks]
- The webhook dispatcher moved from Team Atlas to Team Dune on 2026-04-22. [decision; valid 2026-04-22 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-22-webhooks]
- Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Priya for the webhooks service handover on 2025-09-09. [valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-09-webhooks]
